blocks.text: Why corporate travel management tools feel slow on Mac

You spend your day moving between browser tabs, travel platforms, and email. You likely use tools like SAP Concur or web-based itinerary managers. These platforms often hide key features deep in menus. Finding a specific policy or booking status takes multiple clicks. This adds up when you manage dozens of trips at once.

Many planners report that 51% of their day goes to low-value administrative tasks. You are not just planning travel. You are managing TMC relationships, checking policy compliance, and updating spreadsheets. When you use your Mac, the friction comes from switching context. You look at an email, then go to a spreadsheet, then open a booking site. Each switch breaks your focus.
Using Lazur to manage your travel planning workflow

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen when you ask it to. You do not need to learn a new interface or change your apps. If you are stuck in a complex Excel sheet, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask how to compare two columns. Lazur explains the steps.
If you are using a new app, ask Lazur to guide you through the initial setup process. It will wait for your action after each step.

blocks.text: Common pain points for travel managers

You often deal with fragmented data. Travelers send emails with requests. You check your corporate tools to see if the request fits the policy. Then you update your tracking sheet. This cycle repeats all day. The main issue is the time spent on manual coordination. You are a human bridge between policy and traveler needs.

items: Jumping between browser tabs to compare flight prices.
Manually copying data from emails into expense reports.
Searching for policy documents buried in company intranets.
Managing multiple calendars for different travel groups.
Tracking down missing receipts from busy travelers.

blocks.text: Email is a major bottleneck. You receive over 100 messages daily. Much of this is status checking. Use your voice to draft quick responses. Hold the fn key to dictate a reply. You can speak naturally. Lazur formats the text for you. This keeps your hands on the keyboard for more complex work.
Data analysis and reporting in Excel

Reporting takes 44% of your time. You likely use Excel for this. If you need to add a trendline to a chart, do not waste time searching menus. Ask Lazur where the option is. It will circle the correct button for you. This saves time and keeps you in your flow.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with SAP Concur or other booking tools?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works with any app on your Mac. Because it sees your screen, it can help you navigate menus in web browsers or desktop applications.

faq.question: Is my traveler data safe?
faq.answer: Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It only sees and listens when you hold the activation keys. Your data is not used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my expense reports?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot click buttons or submit forms for you. It can guide you through the process, point out where to enter data, or help you draft the text you need to type.
